description: Source code for OpenAI Moderation Guardrail integration in LiteLLM, implementing content moderation via OpenAI API with hooks for pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming response moderation.

classes.name: OpenAIModerationGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class for OpenAI content moderation, integrating with LiteLLM to scan prompts and responses for harmful content using OpenAI's moderation API.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the guardrail with configuration parameters such as API key, base URL, and model.

methods.name: _get_api_key
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAI API key from environment variables or configuration.

methods.name: async_make_request
methods.description: Sends a moderation request to OpenAI API with input text and returns the response.

methods.name: _check_moderation_result
methods.description: Checks moderation response for flagged content and raises exception if content violates policies.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to scan user prompts before sending to LLM, raising exception if content is flagged.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook during call processing to scan prompts.

methods.name: async_post_call_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to scan LLM responses before returning to user.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Processes streaming response chunks, assembles them, and applies moderation checks.

methods.name: _extract_response_text
methods.description: Extracts text content from model responses for moderation.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.
